name: io.github.williamwangl/fincode-mcp
description: Look up SWIFT, IBAN, IFSC, CNAPS, sort code, BSB, routing and BIN codes, and search banks.

environmentVariables.name: FINCODE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key with the sk_ prefix. Optional: identifier lookups work without it, the five directory tools need it.

environmentVariables.name: FINCODE_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API root including /v1, for self-hosted deployments.

environmentVariables.name: FINCODE_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds; a timeout is retried once.

environmentVariables.name: FINCODE_MCP_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries after the first attempt for 429, 502, 503, 504 and network errors.
